rules.rule: Package a build challenge with a partner and a stake: 'We Built/Made X in N Minutes' or 'Can I … Better Than a Pro Developer?', with a $ value, a clock or an opponent. The co-builder matters: solo 'I Built a $X App' versions flop.
rules.evidence: NnYLzGMk8Tg 38.6 (1.1M views, channel's biggest), aEdRB2yVK-I 12.5, _GMtx9EsIKU 7.54, p-KM4P-6Hmg 5.93. In all.tsv, titles starting 'We built/made/vibe coded' n=6, median outlier 4.18, 4 of 6 at >=2. Titles starting 'I built/made/created/cloned' n=12, median 0.94 (#72 0.33, #73 0.64, #99 0.52). Same series without the breakout: #105 0.84, #84 0.51.

rules.rule: Long beginner courses are the most reliable breakout format: 60+ minutes, a tool name plus 'for Beginners', 'Masterclass', 'Complete Guide' or 'Learn 95% of X', and 10 or more chapters.
rules.evidence: 2itM7IdThvA 17.86 (111 min), 2aldTxnbNt0 14.77 (154 min), 2FJlhoDYNPE 9.69 (96 min), faezjTHA5SU 9.2 (148 min), 474wZZHoWN4 6.2 (29 min), ifz8NGHuHtY 2.83 (115 min). In all.tsv, uploads of 3600s or more: n=18, median 2.58, 10 of 18 at >=2, against a median of 0.87 for uploads under 1800s. 'Beginner/Non-Coders/101' titles: n=8, median 2.66. Misses exist: #78 0.47, #27 0.94, #117 0.82.

rules.rule: Ride a launch with a first-person verdict, not a roundup: one model or tool, one strong claim ('Feels Like AGI', 'Replaced Cursor for Me', 'Explained', 'Gives You Superpowers').
rules.evidence: tR2azlV7RlQ 10.84 (DeepSeek, Jan 2025), 0iGEpx8IeM0 9.9, Ju41cQSe7hY 7.52 (GPT-6 Astra, 752k), dzFUOQUSiEI 5.16 (Gemini 3), kN08-CXWOJs 4.92 (GPT-4o images). None of the 20 uses 'X Is Insane… But Y Is EVEN Bigger' or 'X Just Changed'. In all.tsv, 'Just <verb>' titles n=14, median 1.35, best 3.27. 'Insane… But' titles n=4, median 1.42, best 2.62; all four are in the latest 30.

rules.rule: Put the viewer's identity in the promise ('With No Code', 'For Non-Coders', 'Without Coding', 'for Beginners'). It carried most of the 2024–25 breakouts and has not appeared in a title since about #69.
rules.evidence: No-code wording sits in the titles of NnYLzGMk8Tg 38.6, _GMtx9EsIKU 7.54, faezjTHA5SU 9.2 and SYoYo-FZyno 4.52, and in the thumbnails of kXnW4Hy4Z7o 16.96 ('WITHOUT CODING!') and EZ-Q30WL5L4 4.69 ('NO CODE'). In all.tsv, no-code titles n=27, median 1.18, 9 at >=2. They are all at index 69 or older, and none is in the latest 68. Within index 61–194, and counting 'Non-Coders' too, no-code titles (n=28) have a median of 1.18 against 0.95 for other titles (n=103). Caveat: its last four rated uses were all below 1 (#69 0.23, #90 0.33, #96 0.84, #99 0.52), so it may have worn out.

rules.rule: Put a hard number in the title: a count, minutes, hours, $ or %. Time promises work when they are a feat ('in 10 minutes', 'in 90 Minutes'), not a chore.
rules.evidence: 13 of the 20 have a count, time, money or percent (not counting version numbers), e.g. z-zOs02NH44 'in 10 minutes' 7.57, EZ-Q30WL5L4 'less than 5 minutes' 4.69, 474wZZHoWN4 '95% … 30 minutes' 6.2, 2FJlhoDYNPE '90 Minutes' 9.69. In all.tsv, titles with any digit: n=90, median 1.15. Titles without a digit: n=101, median 0.88.

rules.rule: Thumbnail: a face (usually right, or two faces for a duo), 2–7 words that add a verdict rather than repeat the title, dark background, one orange or yellow accent word. The current desk anchor and dashboard spread are the weakest layouts in this set.
rules.evidence: 19 of 20 show a face, and the median is 4 words. Lines that complement the title: n=11, median 9.69. Lines that repeat it: n=7, median 6.2. The lowercase verdict with an orange pill ('the last tutorial you'll ever need', 'claude made cursor feel dumb', 'this shouldn't be possible', 'idea to app store in one hour') is on 2aldTxnbNt0 14.77, 0iGEpx8IeM0 9.9, 2FJlhoDYNPE 9.69, _GMtx9EsIKU 7.54 and p-KM4P-6Hmg 5.93. Desk anchor: ifz8NGHuHtY 2.83. Dashboard spread: mHqSBCHEZOY 2.61; these are the two lowest ratios of the 20. Two winners have no text: 2itM7IdThvA 17.86 and dzFUOQUSiEI 5.16.

rules.rule: Description: always add chapters, numbered to match the title's count. An own-product link on line 1 did not stop breakouts. Sponsor-led openings and hashtags are almost absent from the winners.
rules.evidence: 18 of 20 have chapters starting at 0:00. The two without are the 5- and 10-minute videos (EZ-Q30WL5L4, tR2azlV7RlQ). ifz8NGHuHtY numbers chapters 1–28 to match '28 Insane Things'. Line 1 is a CTA on _GMtx9EsIKU 7.54, 0iGEpx8IeM0 9.9 and p-KM4P-6Hmg 5.93, all own products (VibeCode, agentnative.inc). Only mHqSBCHEZOY (2.61) is sponsored, and it is the only one with hashtags (#codex #agents #ChatGPT_Partner #aiagents).
